A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Have something else in mind?
We’re happy to talk it through.

Let’s have a conversation
01What services do you provide?

We provide construction and civil works, aggregates and materials supply, excavation and backfilling, machinery and vehicle rental, and interior design and finishing. We are based in Damak, Jhapa, Nepal.

02Can I request only materials or equipment rental?

Yes. You can contact us for an individual materials or rental requirement, or discuss several services together. We prepare a quotation around the type of material or equipment, quantity or duration, and work location.

03What should I prepare for a consultation?

Bring a brief description of what you need, the project or delivery location, and your preferred timeframe. Drawings, reference images, quantities, or measurements are helpful if available, but are not required for an initial conversation.

04Do you handle residential and commercial work?

Yes. Our experience includes residential homes, offices, commercial buildings, and civil works such as roads, drains, bridges, and culverts. Share your requirements so we can discuss the appropriate scope.

05Can you help with interior work?

Yes. We handle tiles and marble work, modular kitchens, bedroom and living room interiors, and related design and finishing work. We start by understanding how you want the space to look and function.

06How do I request a quotation?

Use the free consultation form and choose the service you need. After reviewing your requirements, we discuss a customized plan or quotation. Submitting the form requests a callback; the team will confirm the call with you.
